summary: Is the name Synthia taken, and which existing products come closest to what we are building.
verdict: Name: crowded and risky. synthia.app is a live browser music-maker, and Synthesia is one letter away. Similar apps: nothing combines a rule-carrying section graph with per-note step grids for non-musicians; the closest are Ableton Live follow actions, Wwise/FMOD and Nodal.

summary: Libraries and engines per area, with measured benchmarks for the step grid and the voice budget, plus the plugin API design.
verdict: Tone.js 15.5.66 as a toolkit under our own conductor; DOM grid with a canvas overlay; React Flow; zustand + immer; full-trust plugins with UI slots and a block-type registry; always-complete .synthia files.

summary: Free and open instrument banks (multi-sampled, drums, SoundFont/SFZ, web-ready) and browser-side players, graded with licences.
verdict: Convert a curated set offline to per-note files plus a JSON map, played by a thin velocity-layer wrapper on Tone.

title: MIDI controllers
summary: MIDI controllers and how Synthia should support them.
